capabilities: Display notes on a calendar by file creation date
Open notes from day cards showing title, preview, creation time and tags
Zoom between month and year views and navigate with arrows
Highlight days with color intensity based on note count
Follow the theme's accent color in light and dark mode
disambiguation: Not a journaling or diary-writing tool; it only displays existing notes on a calendar by their creation date.
extras: Warns that file creation dates can reset when syncing or copying notes to a new machine, causing older notes to cluster on the setup day; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Think of it as Steph Ango's Daily Note setup, but automatic and simplified.
motivation: The author wanted Steph Ango's Daily Note setup but automatic and simplified, so the whole vault can be browsed through a calendar.
problem: Obsidian's Daily notes workflow requires manually creating a note each day, so existing notes aren't automatically tied to their creation date on a calendar.

relations.evidence: Think of it as Steph Ango's Daily Note setup, but automatic and simplified.

summary: Calendar view that places every note on the day it was created, letting you browse the vault by date without manual daily-note entries.
